name: glob
description: 按 glob 模式查找文件。支持多 pattern 合并（数组）、{a,b} 大括号展开、! 否定模式、** 任意深度、? 单字符、[abc] 字符类；支持按文件类型过滤（type）、mtime 降序排序（最近修改优先）、offset 分页。默认尊重 .gitignore/.ignore 并跳过隐藏文件与 node_modules/dist/build 等目录。
description_en: Find files by glob pattern. Supports multiple patterns merged (array), {a,b} brace expansion, ! negation, ** any depth, ? single char, [abc] character classes; filter by file type (type), mtime descending sort (most recently modified first), offset pagination. Respects .gitignore/.ignore by default and skips hidden files and node_modules/dist/build directories.

anyOf.description: glob 模式，如 "**/*.ts"、"src/**/*.{json,md}"、"!**/*.test.ts"（! 开头为排除过滤）
anyOf.description_en: Glob pattern, e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.{json,md}", "!**/*.test.ts" (leading ! means exclusion filter)

anyOf.description: 多个 glob 模式，正模式取并集、! 开头负模式从并集中排除，如 ["**/*.ts","**/*.tsx","!**/*.test.*"]
anyOf.description_en: Multiple glob patterns: positive patterns are unioned, !-prefixed negative patterns are excluded from the union, e.g. ["**/*.ts","**/*.tsx","!**/*.test.*"]

path.description: 搜索的根目录（默认：agent 工作目录）。绝对或相对路径
path.description_en: Root directory to search (default: agent working directory). Absolute or relative path

type.description: 按文件类型过滤（等价 rg --type）：ts/js/py/rust/go/java/kotlin/c/cpp/cs/rb/php/swift/md/json/yaml/toml/css/scss/less/html/vue/svelte/sh/bat/sql/xml/astro/graphql。比手写 glob 更不易漏扩展名
type.description_en: Filter by file type (equivalent to rg --type): ts/js/py/rust/go/java/kotlin/c/cpp/cs/rb/php/swift/md/json/yaml/toml/css/scss/less/html/vue/svelte/sh/bat/sql/xml/astro/graphql. Less error-prone than hand-written extension globs

maxResults.description: 最多返回的结果数（默认 200，最大 1000）。
maxResults.description_en: Maximum number of results to return (default 200, max 1000).

offset.description: 分页偏移量（默认 0）。结果截断时配合使用可翻页
offset.description_en: Pagination offset (default 0). Use together when results are truncated to page through them

includeDirs.description: 结果中包含匹配的目录（默认 false，仅文件）
includeDirs.description_en: Include matching directories in results (default false, files only)

noIgnore.description: 不尊重 .gitignore/.ignore 且不跳过 node_modules/dist/build 等默认忽略目录（默认 false）。查找构建产物/依赖时使用
noIgnore.description_en: Do not respect .gitignore/.ignore and do not skip default ignored directories such as node_modules/dist/build (default false). Use when looking for build artifacts/dependencies

dot.description: 包含隐藏文件/目录（. 开头，默认 false）

sortBy.description: 排序方式：mtime=修改时间降序（默认，最近修改优先）；path=字典序
sortBy.description_en: Sort order: mtime=modification time descending (default, most recent first); path=lexicographic

respectGitignore.description: 是否默认尊重 .gitignore（false 等同全局 noIgnore）
